Source-assisted reading of Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 184 (F-fpb6), made on the native images with Mommsen's edition of Rufinus (GCS Eusebius II.1, 1903, pp. 123-127) and P. Bruno Griesser's 1928 collation at hand. Reread on the image: canvas 0 lines 1-8, 11-16, 17-23; canvas 1 lines 1-9, 17-23. Other lines are not given here and rest on the image-only first reading. Regions x,y,width,height in native pixels. ( ) expansion; [ ] lost at the trimmed edge or in a hole, or supplied; ? uncertain.
